_meta.what: Per-channel receipts for the latest published day, drawn from the same sampled ngrams corpus the day's scores are computed from: every English article in the sample whose text matched a registered channel phrase (channel anchor applied per document, identically to the series matcher), tier-sorted using source_tiers.json.
_meta.caveat: Drawn from 48 minute-files covering 30,080 English articles. An article labeled 'in scored sample' is one the day's estimator actually counted; 'in day's corpus' means it exists in the full day's monitored coverage but fell outside the half-hourly scoring sample; 'retrieved' comes from GDELT's bounded relevance search and restores wire originals whose syndicated copies the corpus caught. Tiers order presentation and feed the tier 1-2 share only; they never enter any score.
_meta.citation: Krishna, Ishan (2026). India Geopolitical Risk Monitor. https://igrm.in/
